description:
## What's new

- **Share button in the player.** A share key now sits right beside the add-to-playlist and download keys, so you can share the current song without hunting through menus.
- **Cleaner now-playing header.** The title and artist are centered and the inline album art is a compact thumbnail instead of a large block.
- **Shared links open the app, not the website.** The custom scheme is now lowercase (the standard Android form) and the fallback page shows a clear 'Open in Lunara' button instead of silently doing nothing.
